record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Topology of Manifolds
record.context_brief: Aspherical manifolds with central fundamental group
record.original_question: Let M be a closed aspherical manifold whose fundamental group has nontrivial centre. Does M have a finite cover that admits a principal S^1-action?

evidence.quote: Given a closed aspherical manifold M whose fundamental group has nontrivial centre, we can ask the following: Question A. Does there exist a finite cover of M with a principal S1-action?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $M$ be a closed aspherical manifold (i.e., a closed connected manifold whose universal cover is contractible) such that the fundamental group $\pi_1(M)$ has nontrivial center. Does there exist a finite covering space $\widetilde{M} \to M$ such that $\widetilde{M}$ admits a principal $S^1$-action (a free, smooth circle action)?
artifact.status_search_result: This is a classical question going back to Conner and Raymond on circle actions on aspherical manifolds whose fundamental group has nontrivial center. It is widely cited as an open problem; known partial results exist (e.g., under additional geometric or algebraic hypotheses), but no general resolution appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Aspherical manifolds - Manifold Atlas
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open conjectures concerning closed aspherical manifolds, including questions on group actions arising when the fundamental group has nontrivial center.
status_evidence.claim: The question is listed among standard open problems on aspherical manifolds.

status_evidence.title: Isometries, rigidity and universal covers - Farb, Weinberger
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Conner-Raymond type questions on circle actions on aspherical manifolds with nontrivial center.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is the Conner-Raymond circle action question and is treated as open in general.
